name: Bogyoszló (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bogyoszló: a red and green shield with a white cross, with a helm, a crest and red, green and yellow mantling, above a red scroll inscribed BOGYOSZLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bogyoszló arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
